name: updateSettings
description: Changes the plugin's content and behavior settings, only those given.

description.description: The formatted text shown above the media list, as HTML. Leave it out to keep the current text, or leave it empty to remove it.

carouselImages.description: The pictures shown in the carousel above the list, in order, each with what tapping it does; they replace the current ones. Leave it out to keep them, or pass an empty list to remove them all.

mediaSortOrder.description: How media items are ordered in the app. Leave it out to keep the current order.

categorySortOrder.description: How categories are ordered in the app. Leave it out to keep the current order.

allowSharing.description: Whether people can share media items. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

allowFavorites.description: Whether people can save media items as favorites. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

allowNotes.description: Whether people can add personal notes to media items. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

showMediaSource.description: Whether a link to the media source is shown. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

allowOfflineAccess.description: Whether people can download media items to use offline. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

enableFiltering.description: Whether people can narrow the media list by category. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

showViewCount.description: Whether the number of times an item was opened is shown. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

highlightPlayedItems.description: Whether items a person already played are marked. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

useGlobalPlaylist.description: Whether people can add items to the global playlist; turned off while every audio item is added to the playlist on its own. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

showAddAllToPlaylistButton.displayName: Enable add all to global playlist button
showAddAllToPlaylistButton.description: Whether the button adding every item to the global playlist is shown. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

showPlaylistButton.displayName: Enable navigate to global playlist button
showPlaylistButton.description: Whether the button opening the global playlist is shown. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

continuousPlayback.description: Whether the next item plays on its own; turned off while every audio item is added to the playlist on its own. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

autoplayDelay.description: How long to wait before the next item plays. Leave it out to keep the current delay.

shuffleList.description: Whether the player offers shuffle; it only stays on with continuous playback. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

autoAddAudioToPlaylist.description: Whether every audio item is added to the playlist on its own, which turns off continuous playback, shuffle and the global playlist. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

resumePlayback.description: Whether playback resumes where the person left off; it only stays on while every audio item is added to the playlist on its own. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

bypassInfoPage.description: Whether tapping an item goes straight to its player, skipping its page. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

callback.description: Runs when the settings are saved.

error.description: Why they weren't saved, such as a choice that isn't offered or nothing to change.

result.description: The settings as they now stand.

content.description: The content and app behavior settings.

descriptionHTML.description: The formatted text shown above the list.

images.description: The carousel shown above the list, in order.

items.description: One carousel image and what tapping it does.

allowFavorites.description: Whether people can save items as favorites.

allowAddingNotes.description: Whether people can add personal notes.

allowSource.description: Whether a link to the media source is shown.

allowOfflineDownload.description: Whether people can download items to use offline.

enableFiltering.description: Whether people can narrow the list by category.

indicatePlayedItems.description: Whether items already played are marked.

globalPlaylist.description: Whether people can add items to the global playlist.

showGlobalAddAllToPlaylistButton.description: Whether the add-all-to-playlist button is shown.

showGlobalPlaylistNavButton.description: Whether the button to open the global playlist is shown.

autoPlay.description: Whether the next item plays on its own.

autoPlayDelay.description: How long to wait before the next item plays.

label.description: The delay as shown, such as 2s.

forceAutoPlay.description: Whether every audio item is added to the playlist on its own.

startWithAutoJumpByDefault.description: Whether playback resumes where the person left off.

itemLayout.description: The layout of an item's page.

skipMediaPage.description: Whether tapping an item goes straight to its player, skipping its page.
